habitat_zh: 寒武纪海洋水体教学复原
claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired teaching art using basic recognizable form, not strict scientific reconstruction; no exact species/measurement/locomotion/coexistence claim.

reconstruction_notes.en: Original living whole-organism interpretation: short ovoid barrel with relatively flat poles, eight groups of three broad comb bands, shorter middle bands and converging aboral strands, plus a small conservative aboral capsule. Repeated broad plates express coarse hierarchy without microscopic cilia. Opaque muted sea-green palette and nominal 0.055 m height are artistic choices. No jellyfish bell, tentacle curtain, feeding mechanism, transparency physics or exact preserved cell-count claim. Closed comb parts sit partly embedded in the continuous body surface.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创全身生活复原：两端较平的短卵桶体、八组三联宽栉带、较短中央列与向反口端会聚的条带，并保守表现小型反口端囊状结构。重复宽片只表达粗层次，不表现微纤毛。不透明柔和海绿色与0.055米名义高度为艺术设定。不添加水母钟体或触手幕，不主张摄食机制、透明体物理或精确保存细胞数量。封闭栉片局部嵌入连续体表。

name.zh: Ctenorhabdotus 多栉列桶形栉水母

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish short oval barrel with repeated triple comb bands and flattened poles in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以短椭圆桶体两端较平，具有重复三联栉带搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。
